checks.reason: Every molecule and cell centroid has a position in micrometres; the viewer opens any section whole.
Molecules carry cell_id, overlaps_nucleus and nucleus_distance, so default, nucleus-only and distance-cap conditions come from molecule flags (ADR-0002).

Descriptive only: per-section values and effects for DKD, IgAN, MCD and MN against Control, with no p-values or confidence intervals, because 22 sections come from 19 donors with no published mapping (ADR-0007). See each contrast's inference eligibility.
No cell or nucleus boundary polygons were deposited; the viewer draws nuclei as circles from nucleus area, an approximation.
No morphology (DAPI) or H&E images were deposited, so structure outlines must come from an image rendered from the data itself.
The authors annotated cells in Seurat but did not deposit labels; SpatialScout labels cells with its own frozen marker rules.

GEO lists 22 samples; the paper reports 19 donors (Control 3, DKD 5, IgAN 4, MCD 3, MN 4). GEO does not say which sections share a donor; DKD, MCD and MN each hold one repeat-donor section, and samples with identical files are listed under distinct_sections. Sections are not independent donors, and donors are never inferred from expression.

21 distinct sections among 22 GEO samples, found by comparing checksums of the decompressed raw files: GSM8720419 (x11) holds the same content as GSM8720418 (x10). Every analysis counts each pair once; the copy stays listed in the manifest as a duplicate.
